title: A Man Called Ove
author: Fredrik Backman
summary: A rigid, rule-obsessed widower wants nothing more than to be left alone, but a lively new family next door keeps interrupting his plans. Their persistence slowly draws out the man behind the scowl.
readIf: you like a grumpy hero with a soft centre, and you do not mind crying on public transport.
skipIf: you want to avoid stories that treat grief and suicidal thoughts seriously, even when they are wrapped in humour.

pairings.reason: Another prickly loner whose hard shell hides pain, and whose life is gently opened up by unexpected kindness.
Same author, same blend of comedy and tenderness, built around a farcical hostage situation instead of a neighbourhood.
A lonely older person finds connection in an unlikely creature, with the same warm, quietly sad tone.
